question:
Assertion (A): The solution region of a system of linear inequalities is always a convex set.

Reason (R): A convex set means that if two points are in the set, the entire line segment joining them also lies in the set.
explanation:
Both Assertion and Reason are true.

A convex set is defined as a set in which the line segment joining any two points in the set also lies completely inside the set.

Since the solution region of linear inequalities satisfies this property, it is always a convex set.

options.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.
